The Instrument Reference Data Operations team provides high quality Reference Data to its subscribers from major external market providers under a single operating model. Instrument attributes are sourced, validated, mastered, and distributed via the bank's strategic Reference Data architecture and is used for trading, risk management, fund valuation, settlement, and regulatory reporting. The Asset Reference Data Analyst will ensure timely and accurate delivery of data for internal customers and coordinate with technology and operations change teams to support innovative solutions using artificial intelligence or change requests with Technology.
cond_0088.responsibilities:
Daily validation in the firm's strategic reference data application to ensure quality of data.
Coordinate with data vendors and the technology team to resolve data issues and improve data quality.
Complete all daily and monthly tasks within deadline.
Resolve client queries promptly and professionally.
Attend meetings with internal stakeholders and provide input on products and solutions suitable for client needs.
Escalate all issues promptly and effectively to supervisor.
cond_0088.requirements:
1-3 Years of experience in Fixed Income, Fund Valuation, Pricing or other related roles
Knowledge/understanding of interest in bonds/financial markets and products
Knowledge of industry activities like Corporate Actions, Index Benchmarking, Stock Markets and Fixed Income products
Intermediate to Advanced Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, V-LOOKUPS)
Analytical/problem solving skills and attention to detail
Pricing vendor knowledge (Bloomberg, Reuters) is a PLUS
Strong database/SQL knowledge is a PLUS
Bachelor degree (Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering preferred) or related field
Self-motivated and able to work accurately under pressure to meet deadlines
Able to communicate clearly within a team environment and coordinate across departments as required
Able to work independently and manage multiple tasks concurrently

Within ARDS the Instrument Reference Data Operations team provides high quality Reference Data to its subscribers from major external market providers under a single operating model. Instrument attributes are sourced, validated, mastered, and distributed via the banks strategic Reference Data architecture and is used for trading, risk management, fund valuation, settlement, and regulatory reporting. The Asset Reference Data Analyst will ensure timely and accurate delivery of data for our internal customers and work with our technology, operations change team to drive innovative solution by using artificial intelligence or change request with Technology. The role is integral in the success of our security services organization.
cond_0155.responsibilities:
Daily validation in firms strategic reference data application to ensure quality of data.
Work with data vendor's and technology team to resolve data issues and improve quality of data
Complete all daily and monthly tasks within deadline.
Resolve client queries promptly and professionally.
Participate in meetings with internal stakeholder and help drive products and solutions suitable for client needs.
Escalate all issues promptly and effectively to supervisor
cond_0155.requirements:
Minimum 3 years of demonstrated expertise in Fixed Income, Fund Valuation, Pricing, or other related roles
Advanced knowledge of bonds, financial markets, and products
Deep knowledge of industry activities such as Corporate Actions, Index Benchmarking, Stock Markets, and Fixed Income products
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills including Pivot Tables and V-LOOKUPS
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with exceptional attention to detail
Proficiency in pricing vendor platforms (Bloomberg, Reuters) is a PLUS
Strong command of database/SQL is a PLUS
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred
Exceptional ability to work accurately under pressure and meet deadlines
Strong communication skills with a proven ability to interact effectively across departments
Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously

Instrument, Pricing & Common Reference Data is a center of excellence providing securities reference data to multiple lines of business across the Investment Bank.
Within ARDS the Instrument Reference Data Operations team provides high quality Reference Data to its subscribers from major external market providers under a single operating model. Instrument attributes are sourced, validated, mastered, and distributed via the banks strategic Reference Data architecture and is used for trading, risk management, fund valuation, settlement, and regulatory reporting. The Asset Reference Data Analyst will ensure timely and accurate delivery of data for our internal customers and work with our technology, operations change team to drive innovative solution by using artificial intelligence or change request with Technology. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with reference data, fixed income products, and the systems involved.
